basic_info.description: Jumbo sized two bedroom and two bathroom condominium at Opera Plaza. This condo is a tower unit - all on one level (no stairs). West facing windows with two private balconies. Spacious rooms and large walk in closet. Enjoy all of the benefits of Opera Plaza including on-site management, 24 hour security staff, concierge, 24 hour heated pool and spa, fitness and more. Best central San Francisco location is close to City Hall, cultural venues, transportation and freeways. HOA fee includes water, garbage, high speed internet, building maintenance and insurance, including earthquake insurance, and amenities. Optional leased parking on site.
